doc: The comma ascent of a southern low (lat -50, age 0.9): the poleward shift flips sign with the hemisphere. Float64: rtol 1e-9. Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN).
